requirements.requirement: The system must define a TypeScript interface for prescription behavior data that includes prescribing patterns, condition mappings, and score contribution fields.
The system must ensure the schema supports an array of prescribing patterns with fields for medication class, frequency, and relative usage.
The system must include a condition mapping structure that links each prescribing pattern to one or more clinical conditions using normalized identifiers.
The system must define a numeric field representing the prescription behavior score contribution to the overall provider quality score.
The system must define optional metadata fields for data provenance and timestamp to ensure compatibility with ingestion outputs.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable into JSON compatible with the MessageBubble rendering pipeline.
The system must define a top-level discriminator or type field to allow MessageBubble.tsx to identify prescription behavior content.
The system must ensure the schema supports partial data where prescribing patterns may be present without condition mappings.
The system must ensure the schema supports partial data where score contribution may be missing or null.
The system must validate that all required fields in the schema are explicitly typed and non-ambiguous in TypeScript.
The system must define clear field naming conventions consistent with existing frontend data contracts used by MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must ensure compatibility with backend feature EVAL-P-RX by aligning field names and types with expected backend payload structure.
The system must ensure compatibility with PIPE-RX-INGEST outputs by supporting ingestion-specific identifiers and normalized value formats.
The system must define fallback-safe default values or nullable types for all non-required fields to prevent rendering failures.
